title: The Analog Tapes
description: Worlds.... So many worlds... They all seem to blur.... The more you know.... The more you forget....
body:
_Static…_

_Epilogue plays…_

Hey everyone Blitzzz here please whatever you do don't go into the fog... it follows with white eyes... Forests with no leaves...

_Static…_

I managed to settle for a few days and make a base and decided to help myself to a farmer's delight, some  berry pie… But it seems something is watching me from the tall grass its eyes a peircing red stare none of the other mobs have, its an Anomoly… I managed to close my windows and blinds just to block the stare...

I apricate Mcaw helping me with my doors, windows and decor… I have at least five days rations left I have a few cabbages a couple tomato's, some berry pie and a few sushi rolls. 

_Static…_

There are MANY worlds beyond this one...  some say it is a wonderland... it isnt... I found this portal and it droped me next to this chest....

_Panting as footsteps echo through a brick tunnel._

Don't steal the blind one's block…. I found a book it says it may be my only escape… Please if you find this or see this be vigilant…  God speed....

_Static..._
_End_

Enjoy this mod pack and make your own tape...

"Also I listed a few mods in the epilogue there are a tew more but I dont want to spoil everything, credit to the mod creators for letting me do this."
